title: Tutis Viva 6+ Wild Elegance 2-in-1 Stroller – Savannah Brown 323
description:
The Tutis Viva 6+ Wild Elegance 2-in-1 Stroller in Savannah Brown 323 combines a ThermoCot™ carrycot, a reversible seat unit and a lightweight aluminium chassis. Its refined silhouette and triple suspension are designed for comfortable everyday outings, from city pavements and cobbled streets to forest paths. Made in Europe.

Part of the nature-inspired Wild Elegance limited collection, this stroller brings expressive styling and carefully crafted details together with modern everyday functionality. Savannah Brown 323 combines smooth beige eco-leather with a refined leopard print. Luxurious textures, precision stitching and durable construction complete the design. The specially created EDUSKY™ inner pattern is designed by Tutis to gently engage and soothe your child.

Carrycot and comfort

  • ThermoCot™ carrycot: The complete carrycot weighs approximately 3.7 kg. Its advanced shell uses helmet-grade material for enhanced protection from cold, wind, heat and moisture. Tutis states that its thermal resistance is up to 65.9 times greater than that of standard plastic carrycots, helping maintain a comfortable environment in every season.
  • EDUSKY™ canopy: High-contrast illustrations inside the carrycot canopy are designed by Tutis to support early visual development from the first days, stimulate eyesight and brain development, help train eye muscles and focus, and encourage curiosity and longer attention.
  • SENSORY-TECH lining with SILVER-IONS™: Soft inner fabrics feature gentle textures and raised details designed to encourage sensory and motor development. Tutis's SILVER-IONS™ treatment provides antibacterial protection to help maintain freshness and cleanliness.
  • All-season mattress: The breathable bamboo-fibre cover surrounds a charcoal-infused memory foam core that adapts to your baby's body shape and relieves pressure. Winter and summer sides support airflow throughout the year. Tutis describes the mattress as moisture-absorbing and antibacterial.
  • Ventilated, extendable canopy: Integrated ventilation and an ultra-long canopy extension provide airflow and extra coverage. A toy-hanging loop is built into the carrycot.
  • Adjustable carrycot cover: The leg cover has waterproof zippers to help protect against changing weather.
  • Memory-function adapters: Designed for easy attachment and removal of the carrycot and seat modules.

Seat unit

  • Room to rest: The seat is suitable for children weighing up to 22 kg and offers a lie-flat sleeping area measuring approximately 99 × 37.5 cm.
  • Extended protection: The ultra-long, fully closable canopy includes ventilation. Higher side walls provide additional protection and comfort.
  • Five-point sliding harness: Easy to adjust as your child grows, with soft shoulder protection.
  • One-hand footrest adjustment: Simply lift and set the footrest without pressing buttons.
  • Supportive seat: An ergonomic honeycomb structure inside the seat provides support.
  • Compact fold: The chassis folds with the seat unit attached for convenient storage and transport.

Frame, wheels and handling

  • Triple Shock Absorption System: Front-fork suspension softens bumps and curbs, frame suspension adds cushioning, and adaptive rear suspension responds independently at each wheel. Together, they filter vibrations for a smooth ride across different surfaces.
  • TUTIS ALL-ROAD™ PU wheels: Built for city pavements and off-road tracks, with grip and stability on gravel, forest paths and uneven ground. The tyres resist scratches and deformation and feature a prominent embossed line for smooth, agile manoeuvring.
  • Swivelling front wheels: The 10-inch front wheels swivel through 360° and can be locked for precise control. The rear wheels measure 12 inches.
  • Lightweight aluminium chassis: Weighing approximately 8.2 kg, the frame uses updated geometry for easier steering. It folds compactly for car boots and storage at home.
  • One-Click™ brake: Provides quick, secure stopping.
  • Height-adjustable eco-leather handle: Adjust the handle for an ergonomic pushing position. Eco-leather accents also feature in the stroller's details.
  • Storage for daily essentials: A spacious shopping bag and matching backpack provide room for the things you need on an outing.

Materials and weather protection

The Wild Elegance edition combines a ThermoCot™ thermal carrycot shell, tactile SENSORY-TECH inner fabrics with SILVER-IONS™ treatment, and UV50+, water-resistant, fade-resistant outer fabrics. Waterproof zippers, an adjustable leg cover and eco-leather accents complete the design.

Dimensions and weight

  • Complete carrycot weight: approximately 3.7 kg.
  • Aluminium chassis weight: approximately 8.2 kg.
  • Seat sleeping area in the lie-flat position: approximately 99 × 37.5 cm.
  • Maximum child weight in the seat unit: 22 kg.
  • Wheels: 10-inch front wheels and 12-inch rear wheels.

What's included

  • Carrycot and carrycot cover.
  • Seat unit, protective bumper bar and seat-unit cover.
  • Chassis and wheel set.
  • Shopping bag and backpack.
  • All-season mattress.
  • Rain cover and mosquito net.
  • Chassis carrying strap.
